cohort: Children of mothers with GDM (n=43) and without GDM (n=82)
finding: Children of mothers with GDM had a different gut microbiota composition at birth and at 9 months of age compared to children of mothers without GDM, suggesting a potential link between maternal glycemic control during pregnancy and offspring's gut microbiota development.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was considered as a potential confounder when assessing the association between maternal gestational diabetes mellitus status and infant gut microbiota composition.
